name: PR detail shows the seeded review run, verdict, findings, and the severity filter
description: From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab and confirm the seeded review run renders (verdict 'request changes', 3 findings: 1 CRITICAL + 1 WARNING + 1 SUGGESTION) in its accordion header. The newest run's accordion is open by default (FindingsTab passes defaultOpen to the first run), so the VerdictBanner and the seeded FindingCard ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit') are revealed without an extra click. Also exercises the severity chips (counter + filter in one control, one chip per severity the run HAS, accessible name = 'label count' e.g. 'Critical 1'): clicking the Critical chip narrows the list to the CRITICAL finding, clicking it again clears the filter. The chip names are coupled to the seeded severity counts for PR #482 (1 CRITICAL + 1 WARNING + 1 SUGGESTION) — changing seed.ts's findings changes these names. Exercises the refactored ReviewRunAccordion / VerdictBanner / FindingsPanel / FindingCard / SeverityFilterButtons. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
